review.why: Builds, tailors and exports resumes and cover letters from chat with a stored local profile.
review.summary: Chat-driven resume builder with a 20-feature menu: master profile storage, templates, tailoring, ATS check, cover letters and interview prep. Says never to fabricate and that data stays local.
strengths: Wide feature coverage incl. cover letters
cautions: Tied to an openclaw-style folder layout
Broad and shallow; overlaps other skills

notes: Writes profile and history files under a local ~/.openclaw folder; stores personal data beyond the resume. Runs mkdir commands.
